transkript.t: Anthropic uses Cloud to write 90% of their code
and you can copy exactly how they do it.
Step one, make Cloud run the tests
and show you the output before it's done
so you stop shipping code that doesn't look finished
and one review is not enough.
Keep a review.md file inside your project
and every time you find a mistake, add a new rule to it.
So every review gets smarter than the last one.
Then cap the back and forth at three rounds.
One of their reviews went 50 rounds
before anybody caught it in the morning
so you don't want to burn your tokens.
Want to copy the setup, comment gates
and I'll send you the link.
